title: AIPOCH Open-Science: An Open-Source AI Research Workbench with Reproducible .science Packages
abstract: arXiv:2610.17110v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-assisted research leaves instructions, computations, artifact revisions and checks whose relationships matter when another researcher receives the work. We present AIPOCH Open-Science, an open-source research workbench with portable .science session packages, and specify an exchange contract for these recorded relationships. Version and assessment targets remain attributable while receiving-workspace identifiers can be remapped, eligible contents can be omitted explicitly, and imported history remains separate from a writable fork. A controlled session tested an incorrect first version, a reviewed correction, an unreviewed revision and a planned but unexecuted step. We compared complete and partial exports with source records extracted independently of the exporter, then inspected imports into separate projects within the same installation. translated_title: AIPOCH Open-Science：一个带有可复现 .science 包的开源 AI 研究工作台
translated_abstract: AI 辅助研究会留下指令、计算、工件修订与检查记录，当另一位研究者接手这项工作时，这些记录之间的关系至关重要。我们提出了 AIPOCH Open-Science，一个带有可移植 .science 会话包的开源研究工作台，并为这些被记录的关系指定了一种交换契约。版本与评估目标保持可归因性，同时接收工作区的标识符可以被重新映射，符合条件的内容可以被显式省略，且导入的历史记录与可写的分支保持分离。一次受控会话测试了一个不正确的初版、一个经过评审的更正、一个未经评审的修订以及一个计划但未执行的步骤。我们将完整导出与部分导出同独立于导出器提取的源记录进行了比较，随后检查了在同一安装环境内导入到独立项目中的情况。两种条件均保留了经过测试的版本和评审关联，并保留了未经评审的修订记录（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了 AIPOCH Open-Science——一个带有可移植 .science 会话包和关系交换契约的开源 AI 研究工作台，保证版本与评审等记录关系在导出、导入过程中的可归因性与可复现性。
en_tdlr: The paper presents AIPOCH Open-Science, an open-source AI research workbench with portable .science session packages and an exchange contract for recorded relationships, ensuring attribution and reproducibility of versions and review associations across export and import.
